title: Probiolact (Pro-Bio-Lact)
description: The Natural Biological Additive for Superior Growth and Immunity.
section1-description1: is a natural growth stimulant and biological feed additive designed to increase productivity, bolster immunity, and provide anti-stress protection for both animals and poultry. It is a 100% natural solution that contains no chemicals, antibiotics, or hormones.
section1-description2: It includes milliard strains of beneficial bacteria and yeast, specifically:
section1Items: Essential amino acids and digestive enzymes

advantages.title: Enhanced Digestion:
advantages.description: Increases beneficial microflora and digestive enzymes in the gut, improving the absorption of undigested proteins.

advantages.title: Growth Performance:
advantages.description: Leads to a significant increase in growth by 15-25% over normal rates by improving transformational efficiency.

advantages.title: Blood Health:
advantages.description: Raises hemoglobin levels, which increases oxygen saturation and regulates acid-base balance in the blood.

advantages.title: Viral Defense:
advantages.description: Creates a hostile inappropriate medium in the gastrointestinal tract for harmful viruses, such as the H5N1 influenza virus (Bird Flu).

advantages.title: Fungal Toxin Treatment
advantages.description: Effectively treats fungal toxins and prevents digestive issues like bloating and gluttony.

advantages.title: Immune Stimulation:
advantages.description: Increases the production of antibodies (IgG) and immune bodies in the blood to reduce infections.

descriptions.head: Mortality Reduction:
descriptions.description: Proven to reduce mortality from 50% to 10% in birds challenged with VVNDV and ochratoxins.

descriptions.head: Pathogen Replacement:
descriptions.description: Replaces harmful bacteria like Salmonella, E. coli, and Clostridia with beneficial Lactobacilli and Bifidobacteria.

descriptions.head: Egg Production:
descriptions.description: Increases egg production (especially in the late production period) and decreases the fracture rate of eggs.

descriptions.head: Hatchability:
descriptions.description: Improves the overall hatching rate of eggs.

descriptions.head: Weight Gain:
descriptions.description: Achieves up to 170% weight gain compared to 130% in control groups over a 6-month period.

descriptions.head: Milk Quality:
descriptions.description: Eliminates acidity in milk and increases total milk production.

descriptions.head: Appetite Stimulation:
descriptions.description: Acts as an appetizer that prevents impaction and normalizes PH in the digestive system.

descriptions.head: Metabolism:
descriptions.description: Acts on improving metabolism and increasing overall body weight.

descriptions.head: Oxygen Resistance:
descriptions.description: Increases the number of red blood cells to help fish resist low-oxygen environments.

descriptions.head: Environmental Health:
descriptions.description: Decreases the ammonia rate and reduces water pollution.

descriptions.head: Disease Resistance:
descriptions.description: Protects against bacterial diseases affecting the skin, respiratory, and digestive systems.

descriptions.head: Stress Resistance:
descriptions.description: Increases resistance to stress resulting from high temperatures during labor, lactation, or feeding changes.

descriptions.head: Meat Quality:
descriptions.description: Improves the taste and tenderness of meat.

treatment-description: Doses may be doubled (up to 10 times the standard dose) during treatment periods with no adverse effects.
safety-description: Probiolact is entirely safe with no side effects for animals or humans, even when redoubling the dose.
storage-description: Store in a cool, dry place away from heat and direct sunshine.
